The 2014-15 Danish 1st Division was the 19th season of the Danish 1st Division, which is the second highest football league in Denmark. The season ran from August 1, 2014 to June 7, 2015.

There were a total of 12 teams competing in the league, with the top two teams earning promotion to the Danish Superliga, and the bottom two teams being relegated to the Danish 2nd Division.

Throughout the season, some of the top performing teams included FC Fredericia, Hobro IK, and Viborg FF. Ultimately, Viborg FF finished at the top of the league table, securing their promotion to the Danish Superliga.

Meanwhile, Vendsyssel FF and AB Gladsaxe finished at the bottom of the table and were relegated to the Danish 2nd Division.

The top goalscorer of the season was Pål Alexander Kirkevold from Hobro IK, who scored 20 goals.

Overall, the 2014-15 Danish 1st Division was an exciting and competitive season, with many talented teams and players showcasing their skills throughout the campaign.
